title_en: Final Fantasy 7: Revelation Release Date Confirmed
summary_en: Square Enix has announced a release date for Final Fantasy 7: Revelation, concluding its acclaimed remake trilogy.
body_en:
Square Enix has announced a release date for Final Fantasy 7: Revelation, concluding its acclaimed remake trilogy.
The third and final chapter in its Final Fantasy 7 remake saga will arrive on April 8, 2027, it was confirmed today.
That date arrived during Sony's latest PlayStation State of Play broadcast and just mentioned the title's PS5 arrival — though we know the game will launch simultaneously for all platforms , meaning this is when you should also expect its Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series X/S versions, as well as its PC launch via Steam and the Epic Games Store.
All of the game's cast — Cid, Yuffie, Red XIII, Vincent, Barret, Tifa, Cait Sith, and Cloud — made an appearance, with further battle customization detailed. Sidequests will also now play out different depending who you're controlling and, somewhat weirdly, you can skip through dialogue at double speed, making characters sound a bit like chipmunks.
You'll even be able to leap down from the Highwind into the new region of Wutai, parachuting down to ground level like in Fortnite. Once there — and best of all — you'll be able to wile away hours photographing its cats.
You Can Photograph The Cat In Final Fantasy VII Revelation pic.twitter.com/tzTNNUBMWz
Today's announcement comes as part of the latest showcase from PlayStation. Catch up on everything announced during Sony's State of Play September 2026 broadcast right here.
